name: iso-gary-refusal
checklist_item: G. Classes / CF_PACK_ORIGINALS / Gary -- capture refusal on an ineligible target
description: Prove SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CAPTURE_CATCH REFUSES an ineligible target rather than throwing, and tells the player why. Luck-gated on ROLL_TIER EQ PERFECT, so the seed is searched once and pinned forever.

seed_search.found_note: the seed that lands a PERFECT roll on the capture throw

notes: Gary carries the capture recipes through ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_CAPTURE.Equippable.Passives, NOT through his class Passives. The thrown ability is the vanilla ONLY_RESISTDOWN_ATTACK on that ball; the capture rides it as a recipe.

SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CAPTURE_CATCH conditions, in file order: HAS_ITEM the ball; ROLL_TIER EQ PERFECT; IS_ENEMY; NOT ENTITY_TAG 'BOSS'; NOT ENTITY_TAG 'SCOURGE'; NOT CHARACTER_TYPE 'BOSS'; ENTITY_TAG 'CF_CAPTURABLE'. The PERFECT gate is exactly why this scenario is seed-searched -- waiting on the roll is not a test.

THE BOSS HALF IS NOT BUILDABLE FROM THIS REPO. The three BOSS_* configs the pack ships (BOSS_WOLF_00, BOSS_WOLF_00, BOSS_WOLF_01) carry neither a 'BOSS' nor a 'SCOURGE' config tag, and crucible_combat_spawn places them as ordinary combatants so CharacterComponent.CharacterType reads STANDARD -- they sail through both boss guards. No id whose Tags actually contain BOSS/SCOURGE is enumerable from this repo; there is no vanilla monster catalog in it. So what this scenario proves is the CF_CAPTURABLE half. The boss-guard half stays UNVERIFIED.

WOLF_GRASS_08 is the negative control on purpose: the pack overrides its Tags to [CF_PACK_ORIGINALS, CF_TRAINER_PARTNER, CF_LINE_*, MELEE, RANGED] with NO PLAYTHING_* tag, so the virtual CF_CAPTURABLE tag resolves false and the throw must be refused.

fixture.notes:
REUSES THE batch-4class BED (built 2026-08-26 through real CHARACTER CREATION: Vampiric / Pacifist / Pokemon Trainer / Gary, confirmed on screen and by crucible_party_list). A dedicated bed was not built for this scenario: that party already satisfies this manifest's expect_classes and min_size, and README says extra party members do not invalidate an identity tell that names the subject. bench.py always loads a COPY, so sharing one backup across scenarios is safe as long as they run SERIALLY. Original build recipe for a dedicated bed is kept below.

ORIGINAL: BUILD RECIPE. New campaign -> CHARACTER CREATION for every slot. NEVER crucible_party_set_class: it rewrites ConfigName but not the display name, so the class is right in state and every screenshot shows a stale vanilla name -- that voided a whole verification run here. Save, copy the .ftk2 out of GameRuns\ into %USERPROFILE%\Backups\ftk2-fixtures under this name, then set status to 'built'. Slot 1 = Gary. He must still carry ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_CAPTURE (a class starting Thing, tagged UNLIMITED so it is never consumed) and that ball must hold NO CF_POKE_CONFIG yet, or SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CAPTURE_1 sends the previous catch out at ON_COMBAT_START and the board is not clean. The existing gary-captured-bat.ftk2 backup is the OPPOSITE of what this needs -- its ball already holds BAT_CAVE_00.

setup.why: godmode ON tops HP up every tick and masks every HP effect.

enemies.why: no PLAYTHING_* config tag -> CF_CAPTURABLE false -> must be refused
the closest thing to a boss enumerable from this repo. See notes -- it does NOT carry a BOSS tag, so it does not exercise the boss guard.

steps.label: Gary throws the Capture Ball at the untagged jelly -- must REFUSE

asserts.why: a successful capture removes the target from the enemy side; both spawns still being there is the refusal
the ball must NOT have swallowed an ineligible target

tells.expect: the party HUD card reads "Gary" -- our class, not a vanilla one
the on-screen refusal text "CAN’T BE CAUGHT!" (loc key CF_ORIG_CAPTURE_REFUSED)
the jelly is still on the ENEMY side and absent from the ally HUD

steps.label: Gary kills something -- Smell Ya Later grants EVADE UP

tells.expect: the party HUD card reads "Gary" -- our class, not a vanilla one
an Evade Up icon on Gary's portrait, duration 2
the party HUD card reads "Gary" -- our class, not a vanilla one
nothing that was refused has moved to the player side
